entities.name: Cursus Publicus (Roman Post)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Augustus established a state postal system with relay stations every 12–18 miles across the empire. Riders on fast horses could carry messages at 80 km per day. Rest houses, fresh horses, and armed guards ensured reliability.
